properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured) 2026-10-29: under a 12 KB reading budget a fresh agent scored 5.5/25 from a reflow2 design that held the answers, and 17.5/25 from the same design when one line told it where the current state was kept; nothing in reflow2 cues a newcomer to the record that says where things stand, and search shows that record as a blank hit
properties.source: recall-exp budget runs B12, C12, B36, C36, C12cue (session 5c7a072b), blind-scored; reply sizes measured on the published 0.93.1 binary
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh).
① OBSERVED: increment 8, the recall pilot's finished reflow2 design (422 nodes) answered from with a 12,000-byte reading budget: blind score 5.5/25, cites 0; the notes file under the same budget 14.5. At 36 KB: reflow2 15.5, notes 22.5. Unbudgeted (pilot): reflow2 25, notes 24.5. Expected: reflow2 at least as good under a budget. Not affected: the same design unbudgeted scored 25; traceability tied 25/25.
② PRECEDENT: search_design on the symptom found nothing.
③ CANDIDATES: (1) reply envelope eats the budget; (2) the design holds no current-state summary; (3) search hits show names, and the state summary is a Fragment with no name, so its hit reads blank; (4) the agent's query strategy (outside reflow2); (5) the observation is wrong (self-report vs score).
④⑤ MEASURED: (1) REFUTED: a search reply is 93% hits, a get_node 98% node. (2) REFUTED: frag:state-as-of-12-nov-2025 exists, 4,449 bytes, "CURRENT VALUES ...", and a search for "state as of 12 Nov current" ranks it second, with an empty name. (5) REFUTED as the explanation: blind scores confirm the gap (the agents' own counts were off, 0 full self-reported vs 5.5 scored). (3) and (4) SEPARATED by one run identical but for one line in the prompt naming the frag:state-as-of- records: 17.5/25 (current values 8/8, sums 3/3), above the notes file's 14.5 at the same budget. One run per arm, but +12 is far beyond the 3-point noise bound.
⑥ CLASS: a reader who cannot read everything depends on being told where to start, and reflow2 gives no such cue: the record that says where things stand was a convention the writing agents invented (a nameless Fragment), not something reflow2 serves or points at, and search renders it blank. This is the recall class (req:an-agent-recalls-from-reflow2-what-it-needs-when-it-needs-it-and-the-recall-is-measured) at its sharpest: the knowledge was in memory and not recalled. It would also have stopped the pilot's 4% cue-following (cues that point at the wrong next step).
⑦ NOT PINNED YET: the fix belongs to increment 2 (agent-side cues); its test is increment 3's re-run plus a budgeted re-run.
SECONDARY, writing side (traceability scorer, budget scorer): the design's answers rarely named documents (cites 0–3 of 25 under budget, against 24 for notes); some ids keep stale values (con:roof-load-900kg holds 1,100 kg); the decisions in use stayed proposed; some overrides exist only in prose. reflow2 let all of it through silently.
⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether a reflow2-served "where it stands" read would match the hand-written note; whether the effect holds at other sizes (increment 9). One model (Sonnet), one run per arm.
